'''Nogometni klub Varaždin''', commonly referred to as '''NK Varaždin''', is a Croatian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Varaždin]]. They compete in the [[Croatian Football League]] (HNL), the top tier of [[Croatian football league system|Croatian football]]."}}
